hints.title: Dominant Predecessor Elimination
hints.text: An element is removed by the closest greater element to its left that has not yet been removed.

hints.title: Survival Time Tracking
hints.text: Track the number of rounds required to eliminate all smaller elements situated between an element and its killer.

hints.title: Reverse Monotonic Processing
hints.text: Traversing right to left with a decreasing collection allows tracking the exact step count each element survives.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Step Count Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def totalSteps(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        stk = []
        ans = 0
        for x in reversed(nums):
            steps = 0
            while stk and x > stk[-1][0]:
                steps = max(steps + 1, stk[-1][1])
                stk.pop()
            stk.append((x, steps))
            ans = max(ans, steps)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Each element is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating element removals round by round takes O(n^2) worst case.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes the elimination timestamp using a monotonic stack rather than step simulation.
